1.w: My child, devote yourself to my words and store up my commands inside yourself.

2.w: Keep my commands so that you may live, and obey my instruction as your most prized possession.

3.w: Bind them on your forearm; write them on the tablet of your heart.

4.w: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding a close relative

5.w: so that they may keep you from the adulterous woman, from the loose woman who has flattered you with her words.

6.w: For at the window of my house through my window lattice I looked out,

7.w: and I saw among the naive — I discerned among the youths — a young man who lacked sense.

8.w: He was passing by the street near her corner, making his way along the road to her house

9.w: in the twilight, the evening, in the dark of the night.

10.w: Suddenly a woman came out to meet him! She was dressed like a prostitute and with secret intent.

11.w: (She is loud and rebellious; she does not remain at home—

12.w: at one time outside, at another in the wide plazas, and by every corner she lies in wait.)

13.w: So she grabbed him and kissed him, and with a bold expression she said to him,

14.w: “I have meat from my peace offerings at home; today I have fulfilled my vows!

15.w: That is why I came out to meet you, to look for you, and I found you!

16.w: I have spread my bed with elegant coverings, with richly colored fabric from Egypt.

17.w: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

18.w: Come, let’s drink deeply of lovemaking until morning; let’s delight ourselves with love’s pleasures.

19.w: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a journey of some distance.

20.w: He has taken a bag of money with him; he will not return until the end of the month.”

21.w: She turned him aside with her persuasions; with her smooth talk she was enticing him along.

22.w: Suddenly he was going after her like an ox that goes to the slaughter, like a stag prancing into a trapper’s snare

23.w: till an arrow pierces his liver — like a bird hurrying into a trap, and he does not know that it will cost him his life.

24.w: So now, sons, listen to me, and pay attention to the words I speak.

25.w: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways— do not wander into her pathways;

26.w: for she has brought down many fatally wounded, and all those she has slain are many.

27.w: Her house is the way to the grave, going down to the chambers of death.
